core_claim.P: PM is enabled and executeHedge() is called, which immediately adds a vaultSupplied entry via notifyVaultSupply(spotToken, params.perpAsset) before the HyperCore 0x811 supplied slot exists (hedge order submitted but L1 fill or PM auto-supply never happens)
core_claim.I: A submitted hedge order must not be enough to make protocol accounting and settlement unavailable; accounting should reflect confirmed retrievable backing, not assume an external PM supplied slot exists
core_claim.V: totalBackingSigned() iterates vaultSupplied and performs a strict PrecompileReader.suppliedBalance() read against 0x811; if the slot does not exist the strict read reverts with 'PrecompileReader: supplied balance read failed', bricking accounting and settlement

distinct_impacts.description: Strict suppliedBalance read against HyperCore precompile 0x811 reverts when the vaultSupplied entry exists but the 0x811 slot does not
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: The strict read then reverts with: PrecompileReader: supplied balance read failed

distinct_impacts.description: Only recovery is privileged manual cleanup via removeSuppliedEntry(false, index)
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: The only recovery path shown in the PoC is privileged manual cleanup through `removeSuppliedEntry(false, index)`
